<?php
function generateRandomNumbers() {
    // Initialize an empty array to store the random numbers
    $randomNumbers = [];

    // Loop 10 times to generate 10 random numbers
    for ($i = 0; $i < 10; $i++) {
        // Generate a random number between 1 and 100 using mt_rand()
        $randomNumber = mt_rand(1, 100);

        // Add the generated number to the array
        $randomNumbers[] = $randomNumber;
    }

    // Return the array of random numbers
    return $randomNumbers;
}

// Example usage: Call the function and print the result
$numbers = generateRandomNumbers();
print_r($numbers);
